sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 2x + 4$ in arithmetic series, evaluate $f(5)$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $14$. Substitute $x = 5$: $f(5) = 2(5) + 4 = 14$.

questions.q: Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 12x + 32 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 4$ and $x = 8$. Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 8) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 8$.
questions.explanation: Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 8) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 8$.

questions.q: In $\Delta  ABC$ studying geometric sequences, $m\angle A = 31^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 45^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $104^\circ$. Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (31^\circ + 45^\circ) = 104^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (31^\circ + 45^\circ) = 104^\circ$.

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $5\mathrm{\ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $10\mathrm{\ cm}$. Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $5 \times 2 = 10\mathrm{\ cm}$.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $5 \times 2 = 10\mathrm{\ cm}$.

questions.q: On the coordinate plane, a line with slope $m = 5$ passes through $(0, 5)$. What is its $y$-coordinate when $x = 1$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $10$. Substituting $x = 1$ into $y = 5x + 5$ gives $y = 5(1) + 5 = 10$.
questions.explanation: Substituting $x = 1$ into $y = 5x + 5$ gives $y = 5(1) + 5 = 10$.
